goal: Implement Task 1C on the existing dashboard displaying internship/placement opportunities with matching data, reusing Task 1B logic as a reusable block in script.js, ensuring responsiveness and intact existing functionality, then verify and fix.

steps.title: Refactor Task 1B matching logic into reusable function
steps.description: Extract the internship matching algorithm from Task 1B into a standalone, reusable function in script.js that can accept internship data and return match %, matching skills, and missing skills.
steps.verifyCommand: grep -q 'function matchInternships\|reusableMatch' script.js && echo 'Reusable matching logic verified' || echo 'Function not found'

steps.title: Implement Task 1C rendering logic using reusable matching function
steps.description: Build the Task 1C module that iterates over all internship/placement opportunities, invokes the reusable matching function, and generates display data sorted by highest match %.
steps.verifyCommand: grep -q 'displayTask1C\|sortByMatch' script.js && echo 'Task 1C rendering logic present' || echo 'Task 1C logic missing'

steps.title: Integrate Task 1C into dashboard UI with responsive design
steps.description: Add the Task 1C component to the existing dashboard, apply responsive CSS/markup, and confirm that login, profile, localStorage, and other dashboard features remain fully functional.
steps.verifyCommand: grep -q 'localStorage\|login\|profile' script.js && echo 'Existing functionality intact' || echo 'Potential issue detected'

steps.title: Run verification checks, fix errors, and save changes
steps.description: Execute final checks, correct any syntax or runtime errors, and ensure all modifications are persisted to script.js and associated files.
steps.verifyCommand: test -f script.js && echo 'script.js saved successfully' || echo 'File not found'
